notes.title: Bug Fixes & Improvements 0.3.7.4
notes.notes:
Hello everybody, I know it's been a long time since the last update. This patch is bringing some long overdue bug fixes while I continue to polish a substantial overhaul of the rendering systems to finish up multi-layered map support; work that has been moving slowly forward this summer, though development had been suspended for nearly two years as life has restricted the time and energy I have to devote to development side-projects.


 Fixed glitchy behaviors of Steam Overlay/Toasts on monitors faster than 60hz
 Improved the handling of Draw/Move previews in a game where one or more players is present with high ping
 Fixed a crash when scrolling the mousewheel over non-dice text/empty-space in a dice roll text box
 Fixed a crash and improved steam API reconnect functionality.
 Fixed excessive memory use in excessively large dicerolls
 Fixed some issues in campaign creation with invalid file-path characters in the name.
 Fixed a bug that prevented campaign switching in some cases

notes.title: 0.3.3.1 Hotfix for "Delete token" bug and improvements to Fullscreen-Mode
notes.notes:
0.3.3.1 is now released
* Fixed a bug where you'd be asked if you really wanted to delete your token after every keystroke within the token editor.
* Added overlay style controls to Fullscreen mode that lets you roll dice, place tokens, do initiative, and draw while still fullscreen.
* Fixed a rare crash with the new right click menu not initializing correctly
* Tried to add a message if you run out of system memory, might not appear.

notes.title: Token Quick-Links and Bug Fixes in v0.3.3.0
notes.notes:
Dudes on a Map lets you take your Pen & Paper game online with minimal effort. You can join our little community here on Discord

Version 0.3.3.0 has the following changes:
* Added links to tokens, accessible by right clicking them on the map. Players can add a private (by default) character sheet and a public art link, DM tokens can have the same, as well as additional custom links.
* Fixed most issues with Steam Overlay in Fullscreen mode on player window. Removed some faulty attempts at making this work which caused excessive CPU/GPU usage. The issue was simply a bad interaction with borderless WPF windows, and simply restoring the border while the overlay is active gives good results.
* Added a Delete hotkey for removing tokens from the token editor screen
* Fixed an issue where the server may prevent the DM from reconnecting (not recognizing the old session as disconnected, and not seeing the new session is from the same user)
* Removed measured distances on maps that are set to no-scale.
* Added some smarter initialization logic to the Map Settings in "Add Map" menu. This should initialize the map with similar token size and scale settings so switching modes won't be jarring.
* Campaign Settings file will now restore from a local backup if it's corrupted.
* Added support for small tokens, "Token Size" now goes down to 0.5 scale.
* Fixed token ghosts not always appearing where they were going to be placed.
* Fixed a bug where NPC tokens were lower resolution than intended on some maps.
* Fixed a bug where you couldn't place a token after switching maps with the token on your cursor.
* Fixed an issue with player color not updating the players tokens for themself.
* Fixed an infinite feedback loop when changing token size in multiplayer.
* Fixed a crash if you started/ended campaign name with a space
* Fixed some uncommon input, steam, and multiplayer crashes.
* Fixed an issue where windows would render a non-maximized window ghost when starting up the game window as Maximized.

notes.title: Version 0.3.2.4 Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Version 0.3.2.4 has just been released with a handful of small fixes:

 Optimized the roll history panel, it now opens instantly and starts with the scrollbar at the bottom (most recent roll).
 Added logic to avoid putting new installs settings on one-drive, and any existing DM datas are given an option to migrate the settings (and again each time a save-fault occurs), while player data is moved unconditionally.
 Fixed a few steam-integration crashes, and added logic to initialize steam if it becomes available after you've started.
 (Hopefully) Fixed a server bug where certain disconnect faults could result in excessive updates to the party and potentially overload the server.
 Fixed a rare font crash


Since the last few updates have been without notes, here's the previous patch notes:

Previous Version 0.3.2.3:

 Fixed a number of edge cases when reconnecting players to an existing game, which would result in lost tokens, tokens not showing up, etc.
 Added some failsafe logic that updates player position and tokens when the DM updates map, and player update if their tokens are missing from DM map, ensuring better synchronization
 Fixed issues with failing to connect to a room causing you to get stuck in a state where you can't connect
 Fixed content type radio buttons not appearing for workshop submissions that don't have token images
 Fixed an issue where placing player tokens for the first time would appear differently between player and DM
 Fixed an issue where tokens saved to whiteboard maps would be forced to coordinate 0,0 if X&Y were negative.
 Fixed a rare crash whenever you interacted with the UI with bad data on your clipboard
 Fixed problems with room-code clipboard joining.
 Fixed an issue where newly created tokens would be duplicated the next time you load after renaming.
 Fixed a rare crash from Steam not being able to run its callbacks
 Disconnecting clients are now removed from the player list.
 Cleaned up fault logic in comm layer to generate fewer ignorable reports to me, and to disconnect more cleanly when an error occurs.
 Added some fault handling around mouse clicks to ensure a bad-state is logged and cancels ongoing operations rather than crashing.



The previous two releases (0.3.2.1|2) addressed a problem with connecting to pub servers, and with booting a fresh copy of dudes, respectively.

notes.title: Patch 0.2.2.0 - Awesome Gaming Table features, Quality of Life & Bug Squashing
notes.notes:
To follow along with the development, report a problem, or just say 'hi', Join us in Discord!

This patch has a lot of cool stuff in it for everyone, but if you're on a gaming table it's especially noteworthy. A lot of these changes came by request from users, and it's a lot of good stuff!


 Fixed the steam overlay, it now works just like you'd expect in a game.
 Added a fullscreen option to the player client, in the top right near the local settings button. This will hide the UI and the map will use the entire screen.
 Added Physical sizing options for the player client, in the Local Settings tab, where you can enter your screen size and resolution and how many inches or millimeters you want each grid-square to be, the map will zoom to give you squares of that size (with options to zoom in and out a little bit 2x, 1/2x, and 1/4x).
 Added a lights out button for the game master, which blanks all player screens until the next update view. I added this as a way to reduce player distractions during narrative segments.
 Added a toggle switch that lets the GM disable player drawing and dice (separately), because sometimes people can't behave.
 Added a campaign option to prevent players from moving other players tokens.
 Added logic to save the location of player tokens between sessions. These locations are saved with the map, so each map you've had players on will remember where they were (if the player is in the game at the start of the next game)
 Added some guidlines for token images to the token manager screen.
 Added an option to lock a token in place so it can't be moved until unlocking.
 Added support so that custom images assigned to tokens on the map are now being saved between sessions. I mistakenly said this worked in the tutorial video, so now I've made it work that way.
 Added confirmation dialogs before kicking and banning players.
 Added options so you can choose when you see movement trace and distance overlay (never, always, or during initiative). The new default is always show the movement path, but only show distance during initiative.
 The game tab is now hidden when you don't have a game started.
 Fixed a bug that caused grid-measure tool to be broadcast to others.
 Fixed a bug that spammed my error reporting service if you set NaN or huge values for grid scale.
 Fixed a bug where changing your campaign settings while you had opposed rolls to make in the client would crash the program.
 Fixed a rare crash when moving tokens.
 Removed the little red X at the bottom middle of the screen.


As ever, please get in touch if you encounter problems, have cool ideas, or anything else really.

notes.title: 0.2.1.1 Patch Notes - Fixed 32-bit mode and a few crashes
notes.notes:
Join us on discord to join the beta or follow along with development!



 Fixed an error preventing the program from launching in 32-bit mode.
 Fixed an obscure crash on the Add Token button for the token editor.

notes.title: 0.1.7.1 Patch Notes - Small bug fixes
notes.notes:
Join us on discord to join the beta or follow along with development!



 Fixed Player map jerking around each initiative turn (and probably many other times)
 Fixed a bug where you initial initiative sorts would be wrong (I think)
 Fixed a bug where you couldn't select the roll button if the previous initiative ended on your turn.
 Fixed a bug where unloading maps and deleting tokens weren't getting saved (so they would return when you restart)
 Change tool priorities so you can  no longer grab tokens while using ruler tools or the circle tool (instead you use the tool when clicking, since these often center on your/a character)
 Fixed ALWAYS being asked to save changes when you exit, there may be some things falsely flagging changes, but the biggest offender has been resolved.

notes.title: 0.1.7.0 Patch Notes - Initiative options & Fixes, 64bit support & general polish
notes.notes:
Join us on discord to join the beta or follow along with development!



 Added options to support action-cost systems (multiple turns/round), exploding dice, custom-player roll entry (e.g. 3d6!)
 Added an option to automatically update players when the DM stops drawing.
 Fixed a number of initiative bugs that have been observed by simplifying the network layer.
 Initiative system now lets players who join mid-combat also join the fun.
 Overlay text and lines now scale as you zoom in and out, making it easier to see/read drawing and token move details.
 Added support for 64-bit mode, this allows for larger maps to be used reliably, reduces the down-scaling required to load them.
 Added color circles to the UI where tokens don't have an assigned image, instead of having a blank space.
 Large tokens now present better in the various grid types, a circle-token fills the appropriate hexes/squares to the edges.
 Added gutters around the outside of the map when you zoom out or pan around, giving a little more freedom of movement for panning the map.
 Undo's for token moves are now assigned to the undo stack of the player that owns the token, rather than the person who moved it.
 Drawing a shape/line and then erasing the same will no longer leave residual color behind (this was due to anti-aliasing, so there are some visible jaggies on drawn shapes now)
 Fixed an uncommon player disconnect when moving tokens.
 Fixed a crash when backing up to the beginning while using the grid wizard.

notes.title: 0.1.6.0 Patch Notes - Undo/Redo, Mouse-Click/Scaling Bug Fix, Tool-Tip hiding
notes.notes:
You can now undo/redo drawing and token movement with buttons in the toolbar, or ctrl-z, ctrl-y (as is tradition). DM undo of changes to the map are sent using the update, just like fog changes.

 The big tool help text can be hidden via a 'corner-X', this hide is per-map since usually map shape determines how annoying it is. The Local settings tab in the top right has the option to disable tips entirely.

 Fixed a bug, where screen DPI scaling was not properly accounted for, and caused map to draw smaller than usual within map panel, and ALL mouse clicks on the map would be inaccurate. Only occurred in certain OS/monitor configurations, but made Dudes barely usable.

 When the DM moves a player token, the move-preview is now broadcast to players. NPCs movements are (still) private, and players only see the token pop into the new location.

 Re-Added logic to prevent anyone from grabbing a token that someone else is moving.



Updated later in the evening with the same software version, but now the binaries are all signed.

notes.title: 0.1.5.3 Patch Notes - Themes & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
UI Theme can be changed in the settings tab in the top-right corner in both clients. Red is still default, but added Yellow, Blue, Orange, Purple, Green, and Pink. I plan to research additional options for colorblindness support on the main map-renderer to help resolve potential issues there as well.
 Fixed an exception caused by loading an image from (older?) saves also attempting to save it 
 Fixed a crash due to corrupted image files
 Improved the behavior for snap on all tools, now the draw-preview shows where it will end up according to the snap point
 Improved erase functionality for rectangle/circle tools, this will now erase as wide as it draws (and not leave behind outlines half of the drawn line)


If anyone is still seeing crashes or severe errors after this patch when loading/switching maps, please do get in touch on the forums/discord/kickstarter.

notes.title: 0.1.5.1 & 0.1.5.2 Hotfix Notes
notes.notes:
- Added a grid alignment tool which allows you to match the size of a printed grid or scale on your map.
- Switched from having all maps auto-loaded to only loading the selected map, saving memory and allowing bigger maps
- Split up the map data, image and preview into separate files so they don't have to stay in memory.
- Increased map image area from 4 million pixels to 12 million.
- Increased heartbeat timeout on the public server, so even slow internet can take advantage of the new big maps.

Hotfix:
- Added a message when an access denied error prevents directory or map file creation, asking for help in tracking this issue down as it's a permissions issue I need more info about.
- Fixed an issue where players weren't able to return to previously visited maps.
